title: Bio architecture Formosana
description: bioarch.com.tw BIOARCH is a Taiwanese bio-architecture company based in Taipei, specializing in eco-friendly building materials, natural coatings and green construction technologies. Founded around 2010, it operates at the intersection of biotechnology, architecture and sustainability. Its product range includes non-toxic bio-paints, antimicrobial coatings, natural insulation and decorative finishes for healthy indoor environments. The company serves residential, commercial and institutional projects across Taiwan. Key strengths are natural VOC-free formulations, antimicrobial properties and focus on healthy building certification standards. It positions itself as a leader in sustainable bio-building solutions for the Taiwan and Asia-Pacific market.
